title: Generative Embodied Multiple Behavior Control Systems for Human-like Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.22691v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An enduring and richly elaborated dichotomy in cognitive neuroscience is that of human behavior control mechanisms, divided into habitual versus goal-directed. While existing human-like agent frameworks primarily focus on modeling goal- directed behavior, habitual behavior has been largely overlooked, though it plays a crucial role in human daily life. In this paper, we address this gap by studying multiple behavior control systems that jointly model goal-directed and habitual behaviors. We propose a human behavior control mechanism-inspired framework which the Habitual Controller retrieves cue-triggered behaviors from personal- ized habit memory, while the Goal-directed Controller employs a context-aware world model to predict action consequences and estimate their values. translated_title: 面向类人智能体的生成式具身多重行为控制系统
translated_abstract: 认知神经科学中一个经久不衰且阐述丰富的二分法是人类行为控制机制，分为习惯性与目标导向性两类。尽管习惯性行为在人类日常生活中扮演着至关重要的角色，但现有的类人智能体框架主要专注于建模目标导向行为，习惯性行为在很大程度上被忽视了。在本文中，我们通过研究共同建模目标导向行为和习惯性行为的多重行为控制系统来填补这一空白。我们提出了一种受人类行为控制机制启发的框架，其中习惯控制器从个性化习惯记忆中检索由线索触发的行为，而目标导向控制器则采用情境感知的世界模型来预测动作后果并估计其价值。仲裁器根据个体差异和瞬时内部状态动态平衡这两个系统的影响。为了重建多样化的人类水平行为（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种受人类行为控制机制启发的框架，通过习惯控制器、目标导向控制器和仲裁器三个模块共同建模习惯性与目标导向行为，并根据个体差异和内部状态动态平衡两者，从而填补了类人智能体研究中习惯性行为建模的空白。
en_tdlr: Proposes a human behavior control mechanism-inspired framework that jointly models habitual and goal-directed behaviors through a Habitual Controller, a Goal-directed Controller, and an Arbiter that dynamically balances the two systems based on individual differences and momentary internal states, filling the gap of habitual behavior modeling in human-like agents.
